what_it_is: Majora's Mask, 1 Mbit FlashRAM: File 1 LINK, File 2 FZS. 131072 bytes, file dated 2023-12-17 12:02.
note: Attributed to the MiSTer N64 core by the issue ('The new core has all the different possible file types split up') and by the names: '<ROM stem>.eep/.sra/.fla' and '<ROM stem>_1.cpk' are what MiSTer's Main (support/n64/n64.cpp) names N64 saves, and '_N.cpk' is MiSTer's alone. The file dates (Dec 2023 - Feb 2024) are after Main's December 2023 change that split the old single .sav into one file per chip and pak. Main of that time created new save files filled with 0x00 (0xFF since Main commit bc49794, 2026-01-13). FlashRAM in the same 32-bit word-swapped order as the libretro .srm ('ZELDA3' reads 'DLEZ'/'..3A'); unused bytes are 0x00 (129037 of them), not the 0xFF an erased flash reads. Copied unchanged into the FlashRAM region (0x28800) of a Mupen64Plus-Next .srm, the file select shows both files: proof.png is that check.
